items.title: Who may charge you
items.text: The landlord's agent may charge you only a capped share of the visit, file, lease and inventory costs. We check what you are asked to pay, and by whom.

items.title: The rent cap
items.text: The lease must state the reference rent and cannot exceed the increased reference without a justified complément. We run the check.

items.title: The deposit
items.text: One month's rent unfurnished, two furnished, by law. Agents still ask for more, or months in advance. We don't let them.

items.title: Lease type
items.text: Unfurnished, furnished or bail mobilité: each sets notice, deposit and rights. We check which you're handed, and which charges are yours.

papers.summary: The papers a French landlord asks for
papers.tail: The rest we go through on the free call.

items.q: When do I pay BOOM Paris?
items.a: When you order, by card on this page: three flat fees, VAT included, never a percentage of your rent. Full Search is refunded in full if we decline the search in the first call. The landlord's agent may charge you only a capped share of a few costs.

items.q: What happens on the free call?
items.a: A call with Valentino, by phone or WhatsApp, at a time that suits you both. We hear your dates, budget and who is moving, say which service fits, or that none does, and which papers you are missing. Nothing is charged for the call. Full Search is refunded in full if we decline the search in the first call.

items.q: I have no guarantor in France. Can I still rent in Paris?
items.a: Plan for it: many landlords want a guarantor who lives in France and turn down one abroad. If you qualify, Visale, a free guarantee from Action Logement, can stand in; if not, a paid guarantee service. Application Pack sets that guarantor or Visale strategy. No landlord is obliged to accept a file.

items.q: How do I avoid a rental scam in Paris from abroad?
items.a: Never pay a deposit or first rent for a home nobody on your side has seen. With Attended Viewing (€149) a BOOM person visits it in your place, with live video and a written report. With Full Search or Application Pack we also check the lease and the rent cap before you sign.

items.q: What if you don't find anything?
items.a: We tell you in the first call if your budget and timeline don't fit the market; if BOOM declines the search then, the €500 Full Search fee is refunded in full. Once we take it on, the search runs until you sign or stop it, six months at most, and the fee pays for the work, not for a result.

rows.ddHtml: BOOM Paris, the tenant-side rental desk of BOOM — operated by Egidi Immobiliare S.r.l., an Italian real estate agency registered in Rome. Hired by the tenant and paid by the tenant only, never by the landlord or the landlord's agent.
Expats and internationals relocating to Paris — employees, researchers, couples and families — from abroad or already in the city.
English; the one-page presentation goes in French.
No percentage of the rent, nothing from landlords or platforms.
French-format dossier within one working day of your papers, applications as listings appear, attended viewings with live video and written report, rent cap and lease checked before you sign.
We don't list homes, we don't represent landlords, we don't collect your rent or deposit, and we don't promise a date.

footer.statement: BOOM Paris acts solely as a tenant-side search agent. We do not list properties, represent landlords, or receive remuneration from landlords or their agents.
